reviews.decision_reason: The unit selects every supplied row because all demand_score values are >= 3, so it promotes demand claims from bare need text and scores without any supplied observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, or outcomes. The context does not show an implementation defect against the mechanical input/output handoff, but under the strict market-demand criteria the selected needs are not independently substantiated.

The unit retains the allowed record identifiers n06-r01 through n06-r08, normalizes numeric fields, applies the bounded eight-row window, and preserves the normalized needs handoff visible in the assigned job output. The omitted demand-substantiation evidence remains a package-level limitation rather than a localized normalization fault.

The unit deterministically ranks normalized needs by descending demand_score with record_id as the tie-breaker and assembles the evidence_sources handoff matching the supplied upstream output. No contradictory evidence in the supplied package localizes a provenance assembly fault.
